title: Northbeam TechWorks Fee Schedule: Calling Work Off and Failed Attendance
content:
Two fees arise from an attendance that does not happen as booked. These are the figures each Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair service carries: the hours of notice needed to call the work off without a fee, the fee charged when the work is called off inside that notice period, the fee charged when nobody is at the address or the item is not brought in, and the minutes the crew waits at the address before a failed attendance is recorded.

| TechWorks service | Notice to call off, hours | Fee for calling off late, USD | Failed-attendance fee, USD | Minutes the crew waits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 24 | 45.00 | 69.00 | 20 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 48 | 75.00 | 99.00 | 30 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 24 | 55.00 | 79.00 | 20 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 48 | 125.00 | 150.00 | 30 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 12 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 30 |

### Reading the schedule

**Two services carry neither fee.** At the store counter both figures stand at 0.00 and no waiting time is kept, the item being brought in rather than attended. Under TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual both fees also stand at 0.00, although 12 hours of notice and a 30-minute wait are still recorded against it.

**Where both fees are carried, the failed-attendance fee is the larger.** 69.00 USD against 45.00 on a standard home installation, 79.00 against 55.00 on an appliance installation, 99.00 against 75.00 on a calibration, and 150.00 against 125.00 on a business deployment.

**The notice period and the waiting time move together.** The two services asking 48 hours of notice, the calibration service and the business deployment service, are also the two chargeable services whose crews wait 30 minutes; the two asking 24 hours wait 20 minutes.
